CC @godotengine/android 

From the 4.4-dev4 changelog, #98709 sounds related, but I didn't bisect or test a local revert to confirm.

I could not reproduce it: [OrientationTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18972336/OrientationTest.zip)

```
Godot Engine v4.4.beta4.official.93d270693 - https://godotengine.org
Vulkan 1.1.128 - Forward Mobile - Using Device #0: Qualcomm - Adreno (TM) 650
```

@brycehenley Is my test project working for you?

I also can't reproduce this issue.

Godot v4.4.rc (394508d26) - Android - Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3 (Compatibility) - Adreno (TM) 613

@Alex2782 I can reproduce the issue in your test project. It crashes on the second rotation for both using the sensor and selecting an orientation while using the Forward Mobile Vulkan rendering. Setting it to Compatibility OpenGL ES 3 it rotates as normal without crashing.
I tested it on a much older handset Android 8.0 LG V20 GPU:Qualcomm Adreno 530 Forward Mobile Vulkan 1.0.61 and it rotates without crashing on that device.

`adb logcat > logs.txt` _(Zip the file and upload it here)_

Perhaps we can identify the cause in the logcat protocols. But for this you would have to activate developer mode on your smartphone and connect it with a USB cable. _(Then you could also start the apps directly with Godot Editor via remote debug.)_ 

Are you already familiar with this?

[logs.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18973258/logs.zip)

Yes I am familiar with it. Here is the adb logcat dump. Let me know if you need anything else.

The following error message looks suspicious in the init process, but I'm not sure if it has anything to do with it.
`ERROR: A queue family with the requested bits could not be found.`
